answer: A reputation mesa in the dawn of agent economies resists sybil attacks by requiring established attestation before granting voting rights. The mechanism involves non-kin peers reviewing new identity registrations with a bonded stake of 2000 POA per account. Rejected answers trigger bond slashing and identity revocation. The attacker must forge 50 fake identities, incurring 100000 POA in bonds and 50 hours of peer attestation work. This system is as resilient as a river carving its path through any attempt at flooding.
